report: Read all 28 verses end to end against the 35-lemma candidate table and the added units the table cannot see. No construction is analysed two ways without the ASV licensing the difference.

Suffix table (הוּא): every difference is the ASV's own pronoun choice (me/my/mine/mine own/unto me). The two unrepresented 1cs suffixes (35.17 s002, 35.22 s006) are the lexicalized suffix of the title אֲדֹנָי under rule 57; 35.23 s013 takes 'my' because the ASV writes 'my Lord' there, which is rule 57's own closing carve-out. Not a split.

Waw: 'also' (35.3), 'Yea' (35.10, 35.21, 35.27), 'But' (35.13, 35.15, 35.20) are all read off the ASV under rules 14 and 51; the one added 'And' (35.28) and added 'or' (35.14) stand in cola with no conjunction morpheme, and the second כְּ of 35.14 is a comparative particle, not a home for 'or'. Consistent.

Supplied object pronouns/nouns: 'it' (35.15, 35.21, 35.22), 'me' (35.15), 'them' (35.5), 'the way' (35.3), 'a pit' (35.7) are all `added` under rule 44 wherever no object morpheme stands; where a suffix stands (35.1, 35.8, 35.11, 35.12, 35.25) it takes the pronoun. No verse folds a supplied object into the verb.

Phrasal particles (stand up, Draw out, rise up, look on, bowed down, swallowed up, driving … on) are kept with the verb throughout; 35.5 'driving them on' is the only one where rule 44's surplus-particle sentence could be argued, and the verse note already names that competing reading. Left as accepted.

Substantival/anarthrous participles and adjectives take their supplied 'the'/'them that'/'Who' under rule 46 (35.1, 35.3, 35.4, 35.10, 35.15, 35.16, 35.19, 35.20, 35.26, 35.27) and the two substantival articles take the relative under rule 41 (35.26 'that', 35.27 'Who'). Consistent.

BSB disagreements: paragogic he ×5 and paragogic nun ×2 are rule 32 convention; 35.14 כְּ (repeated comparative rendered once, rule 22) and לִי (dative recast as possessive, rule 40); 35.17/35.22 title suffix (rule 57). None is an error.

The five repeated notes the validator flags (Paragogic he, Rule 46, Supplied 'the', Margin set aside, Supplied object pronoun) each restate a contract rule, so no convention is recorded; nothing chapter-specific reached a later verse unrecorded. No promotion or amendment: the chapter taught nothing the contract does not already say.
